lessons.description: Wi-Fi coverage was only measured after planning, which led to CR-001.
lessons.action_plan: Include an infrastructure survey in the initiation of projects with mobile devices.

lessons.description: The vendor's outdated API documentation delayed the integration by two weeks.
lessons.action_plan: Validate the technical documentation with the vendor at the kickoff meeting.
lessons.notes: Added to the standard kickoff agenda.

lessons.description: Training held at the gate itself sped up the team's adaptation.
lessons.action_plan: Keep on-site training in similar rollouts.

lessons.description: Weekly measurement of service time made it possible to track the target from the start of operation.
lessons.action_plan: Define the indicator and how it is measured in the charter of future projects.
